public_body: University Of Massachusetts Board Of Trustees
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Committee lacked a quorum, so it did not deliberate, was not holding a meeting, and had no duty to keep minutes. Resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Advancement Committee met June 3 and discussed business without a quorum present.
allegations.key_passage: Here, because a quorum of the Committee was not present, it did not deliberate, thus there was no meeting requiring compliance with the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee failed to record minutes of the June 3 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, the Committee was not obligated to record meeting minutes.
